intelligence.enrichment: Many people leave food unconsumed on their plates, but food should be respected because farmers and other community members put time and effort into getting food from the farm to the plate. recognising farm-to-plate effort -> taking only needed food and reducing waste The learner correctly applies this rule: Many people leave food unconsumed on their plates, but food should be respected because farmers and other community members put time and effort into getting food from the farm to the plate. Food left on a plate is only a personal matter and has no connection to farmers or community effort.
